LESSON: BOOK HANDLING SKILLS 1/

Grade: PP1
Subject: LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: WRITING
Topic 4.1: Book handling Skills 1/

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Book handling Skills 1/. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How do we arrange Skills (1 1/2HRS) learner should be able to: demonstrates how to turn pages books on shelves?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. explain what Book handling Skills 1/ means in simple pupil language
2. give 3 correct examples of Book handling Skills 1/ from Kenya
3. practise Book handling Skills 1/ in clear steps
4. apply Book handling Skills 1/ in one real-life situation this week

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: BOOK HANDLING SKILLS 1/
Subject: LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES · Grade: PP1
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Book handling Skills 1/ helps you succeed in LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

KEY FACTS: BOOK HANDLING SKILLS 1/
Study Book handling Skills 1/ like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Explain what Book handling Skills 1/ means in simple pupil language

What this means
In this part you learn to explain what Book handling Skills 1/ means in simple pupil language. You will use ideas from at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: explain what Book handling Skills 1/ means in simple pupil language.
2. Listen, speak, read, then write using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Model reading: Read a short paragraph about “Book handling Skills 1/”, then retell it in 3 sentences.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can explain what Book handling Skills 1/ means in simple pupil language. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Give 3 correct examples of Book handling Skills 1/ from Kenya

What this means
In this part you learn to give 3 correct examples of Book handling Skills 1/ from Kenya. You will use ideas from at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: give 3 correct examples of Book handling Skills 1/ from Kenya.
2. Listen, speak, read, then write using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Model speaking: Say 4 clear sentences about Book handling Skills 1/ to a partner.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can give 3 correct examples of Book handling Skills 1/ from Kenya. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Practise Book handling Skills 1/ in clear steps

What this means
In this part you learn to practise Book handling Skills 1/ in clear steps. You will use ideas from at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: practise Book handling Skills 1/ in clear steps.
2. Listen, speak, read, then write using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Model writing: Write 5 neat sentences using new words from this lesson.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can practise Book handling Skills 1/ in clear steps. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 4: Apply Book handling Skills 1/ in one real-life situation this week

What this means
In this part you learn to apply Book handling Skills 1/ in one real-life situation this week. You will use ideas from at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: apply Book handling Skills 1/ in one real-life situation this week.
2. Listen, speak, read, then write using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Model reading: Read a short paragraph about “Book handling Skills 1/”, then retell it in 3 sentences.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can apply Book handling Skills 1/ in one real-life situation this week. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Book handling Skills 1/ is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Read a short paragraph about “Book handling Skills 1/”, then retell it in 3 sentences. (skill: explain what Book handling Skills 1/ means in simple pupil language)

Example 2: Say 4 clear sentences about Book handling Skills 1/ to a partner. (skill: give 3 correct examples of Book handling Skills 1/ from Kenya)

Example 3: Write 5 neat sentences using new words from this lesson. (skill: practise Book handling Skills 1/ in clear steps)

Example 4: Read a short paragraph about “Book handling Skills 1/”, then retell it in 3 sentences. (skill: apply Book handling Skills 1/ in one real-life situation this week)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Book handling Skills 1/ to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: explain what Book handling Skills 1/ means in simple pupil language.
3. Practise this skill: give 3 correct examples of Book handling Skills 1/ from Kenya.
4. Practise this skill: practise Book handling Skills 1/ in clear steps.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Book handling Skills 1/ from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Book handling Skills 1/: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a PP1 learner study Book handling Skills 1/?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do we arrange Skills (1 1/2HRS) learner should be able to: demonstrates how to turn pages books on shelves?
2. what ways do learners a) Demonstrate how to handle books • Learners could be encouraged to mishandle books?
3. How do we take care of b) Enjoy participating in book right as demonstrated. books?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Book handling Skills 1/ means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: explain what Book handling Skills 1/ means in simple pupil language.
5. Be able to: give 3 correct examples of Book handling Skills 1/ from Kenya.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
